messages:
Maya (Design): dropped a compact mock for autoscale controls: min/max, burst toggle, GPU pool selector, and SLO slider. looking for quick UX + a11y review. figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz
Alex (Product): nice. make SLO feel approachable 100 ms as a balanced default + helper copy.
Samir (Eng): note: pools are g4, l4, a100. dropdown should show approx qps and $/hr. API can return values.
Maya (Design): plan: two-line dropdown rows: name + small text "~600 qps  $2.80/hr". fits?
Leah (Accessibility): a11y nits: slider must support arrow keys (1%) and PgUp/PgDn (10%). secondary text contrast needs boosting to 4.5:1. GPU dropdown needs typeahead and aria-activedescendant.
Samir (Eng): add guardrail: if SLO <60 ms and pool=l4, show warning: "Estimated p95 ~120 ms with this pool." we'll compute estimate server-side.
Maya (Design): draft guardrail wording: "Note: estimated p95 with selected pool is ~120 ms. Consider a higher-performance pool or enabling burst."
Leah (Accessibility): good. mark the warning with role=\"status\" so screen readers announce it.
Jon (SRE): burst tooltip text: "Temporary burst capacity uses spare GPU slots for short spikes; billed while active. Default cap = 2x reserved." ops wants telemetry: capacity.burst.triggered {team_id, pool, duration_s}.
Samir (Eng): will emit that event when burst allocation succeeds.
Maya (Design): about min/max defaults: show recommended band from org history, e.g., "Recommended: min 2  max 8" with one-click apply. backend API: /orgs/{id}/autoscale/suggest.
Alex (Product): include confirmation if new min > current instances: "Apply and migrate (may restart)" vs "Apply without migration".
Maya (Design): i'll update figma with contrast fixes, aria notes, updated guardrail copy, burst tooltip, and recommended range UI. ops-bot will post the updated link when ready.
ops-bot: uploaded updated figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz?node-id=99 :thumbsup:
Alex (Product): acceptance criteria draft: 1) accessible SLO slider; 2) GPU pool rows show qps and $/hr + typeahead; 3) burst toggle w/ tooltip & billing note; 4) guardrail appears with role=status; 5) recommended min/max shown with one-click apply.
Maya (Design): thanks all 1 will post updated mock tomorrow. :sparkles:
